content: Static configuration between ConsumedServiceInstance and ProvidedServiceInstance If the ConsumedServiceInstance contains a remoteUnicastAddress reference to an ApplicationEndpoint the SoAd will setup one single SocketConnection between the localUnicastAddress and the remoteUnicastAddress .
